phase_prompt.summary: The radiant, amber-construct guardian of the Tree Node.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: The entity 'Life' standing as a guardian in the Tree of Life Node. A humanoid figure sculpted from translucent amber, inner golden light illuminating complex circuitry veins. Face is a featureless golden hexagonal grid. Robes of dark roots and glowing cables. Atmosphere of heavy gold dust and static. Cinematic, hyper-realistic, 8k resolution, ancient-tech aesthetic.
